latestVersion.changelog:
tavern-card v1.0.0 initial release

- Full support for importing, parsing, converting, and exporting SillyTavern character cards.
- Handles all V1/V2/V3 card specs, compatible with both PNG (embedded JSON) and pure JSON formats.
- Automatic format detection, validation, and conversion between versions.
- Supports extracting/embedding character data in PNG files via tEXt/iTXt chunks.
- Documentation includes practical usage instructions and error handling guidance.
